fact_text: A property share sells fractional ownership units of an apartment, for example 100 sq ft of a 1,250 sq ft unit, and each unit can be resold at market valuation like a share.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can’t Buy Property? Check Out Naya Nazimabad’s Property Share Scheme | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-21)

fact_text: Unit holders receive a pro-rata share of the rent from the apartment, and the sponsor's plan is to sell the property once prices peak and distribute the proceeds to unit holders.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can’t Buy Property? Check Out Naya Nazimabad’s Property Share Scheme | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-21)

fact_text: The property share scheme is managed by Arif Habib Dolmen REIT Management, which charges a 2% management fee and distributes the rest of the income to unit holders.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can’t Buy Property? Check Out Naya Nazimabad’s Property Share Scheme | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-21)

fact_text: The standard plan described for a Rs 14 lakh unit is a Rs 280,000 booking payment and Rs 16,000 monthly instalments over 82 months, with possession about 48 months after launch.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can’t Buy Property? Check Out Naya Nazimabad’s Property Share Scheme | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-21)

fact_text: Standard apartment sizes in the project are 1,250 sq ft (two-bed, divided into 12 units of 100 sq ft) and 1,750 sq ft (three-bed, divided into 17 units).
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can’t Buy Property? Check Out Naya Nazimabad’s Property Share Scheme | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-21)

fact_text: The project is described as a gated community where each flat gets its own car parking space and a separate visitor parking area is provided.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can’t Buy Property? Check Out Naya Nazimabad’s Property Share Scheme | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-21)

fact_text: The company's guest said the property share scheme could return about 40 to 50 percent, helped by a long payment plan and rent starting about 48 months after launch.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can’t Buy Property? Check Out Naya Nazimabad’s Property Share Scheme | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-21)

fact_text: The company's guest argued the units are undervalued before possession and that prices should rise once possession starts, citing the pattern in earlier Karachi projects.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can’t Buy Property? Check Out Naya Nazimabad’s Property Share Scheme | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-21)

fact_text: The company's guest said the scheme was approved by regulators and described it as low-risk, with the investor's only variance being the profit or loss on the property share; this is a sponsor's claim, not an independent assessment.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can’t Buy Property? Check Out Naya Nazimabad’s Property Share Scheme | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-21)

fact_text: The guest said real estate projects in Pakistan generally return no more than about 20 percent, which he used as the benchmark against the scheme's claimed return.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can’t Buy Property? Check Out Naya Nazimabad’s Property Share Scheme | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-21)
